title: Listen to a retrospective and write the actions (B2)
summary: Listen to a team retrospective about a failed release and write the root causes and agreed actions.
learningObjectives: Follow a blame-free discussion of what went wrong
Separate causes from actions and owners
Write concise retrospective notes in English

turns.text: Welcome to the retro for last Thursday's release. Remember, we look at the process, not at people. Let us start with what went well.
The build was fast and the tests passed. I also think the release notes were clear, so support knew what changed.
Thanks, Tom. Now, what went wrong?

The release broke the payment page for forty minutes. We had no rollback plan, so we fixed the problem live. I also saw the alert at the start, but it looked the same as many old alerts, so I did not react at once.
To be fair, I did not know the new config option was required. It was only mentioned in a chat thread, not in the release checklist.
So we have two causes: a missing rollback plan and a checklist that does not include config changes. Is there a third?
Yes, alert fatigue. Too many alerts are noisy, so important ones are easy to miss.
Good. Let us agree actions. Tom, can you add config changes and a rollback step to the checklist by the next sprint?
Yes, I can do that. I will ask Lena to review it.
I will review it and also clean up the alert rules. I need two weeks for that, and I would like the team to help me decide which alerts matter.
Perfect. I will put both actions on the board and we will check them at the next retro.

gist.question: What is the team discussing?
gist.explanation: Cuộc họp rà soát lần phát hành bị lỗi.

detail.question: How long was the payment page broken?
detail.explanation: Lena nói trang thanh toán hỏng bốn mươi phút.

detail.question: Which problem is a process gap, not a technical bug?
options: The build was slow for the team right now
detail.explanation: Danh sách kiểm tra thiếu thay đổi cấu hình.

detail.question: Why did Lena not react to the alert immediately?
options: It looked like many old alerts
She was on holiday for the team
correctAnswer: It looked like many old alerts
detail.explanation: Cảnh báo quá nhiều nên bị bỏ qua.

detail.question: Who will update the release checklist?
detail.explanation: Tom nhận việc thêm bước vào checklist.

detail.question: How long does Lena need for the alert cleanup?
detail.explanation: Lena cần hai tuần để dọn cảnh báo.

listeningNotes.prompt: Take short notes while you listen; they are not saved.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Lý do sâu nhất khiến sự cố xảy ra.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Viết root cause thành hai từ.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Hoàn tác một lần phát hành để khôi phục dịch vụ.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Danh từ viết rollback, động từ viết roll back.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Mệt mỏi vì quá nhiều cảnh báo nên bỏ sót cái quan trọng.
vocabulary.example: Alert fatigue makes us miss real problems.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Việc cụ thể có người phụ trách và thời hạn.
vocabulary.example: We agreed on two action items.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Viết action item thành hai từ.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Tập trung vào quy trình thay vì cá nhân.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Blameless là một từ, nhấn âm đầu.

expressions.meaning: Phân biệt nguyên nhân với triệu chứng.
expressions.example: The root cause was a missing checklist step, not a careless engineer.

expressions.meaning: Nêu thiếu sót và hậu quả.
expressions.example: We had no rollback plan, so we fixed the problem live.

expressions.meaning: Giao hành động có người và hạn.
expressions.example: To prevent this, Tom will add a rollback step by the next sprint.

expressions.phrase: We will review this at the next retro.
expressions.example: We will review both actions at the next retro.

exercises.question: Which sentence is blameless?
options: The checklist did not include config changes.
Tom forgot the config change again. for the team
Lena was careless with the alert.
correctAnswer: The checklist did not include config changes.
exercises.explanation: Câu blameless nói về quy trình, không đổ lỗi cho cá nhân.

exercises.question: Điền từ: We had no rollback plan, ___ we fixed it live.
exercises.explanation: So nêu hậu quả của thiếu sót.

exercises.question: Sắp xếp phần ghi chú retro.
exercises.explanation: Điểm tốt, điểm sai, nguyên nhân, hành động.

performanceTask.title: Write retrospective notes
performanceTask.scenario: After a retro, you write the notes that list the causes and the agreed actions.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: From the rough notes of a retrospective, write notes in English (60 to 110 words): root causes, actions and owners. Do not look at the model answer yet.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Write retrospective notes in English, 60 to 110 words: the root causes, the agreed actions and the owner and date of each action.
performanceTask.modelResponse: Retro notes: Thursday release. The payment page was down for forty minutes. Root causes: first, there was no rollback plan; second, the release checklist did not include config changes; third, alert fatigue meant the first alert was missed. Actions: Tom will add config changes and a rollback step to the checklist by the next sprint, and Lena will review it. Lena will clean up the alert rules within two weeks, with help from the team to decide which alerts matter. Priya will track both actions on the board and we will review them at the next retro.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Write the notes again in English. Keep the same structure and separate causes from actions more clearly.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Write notes for a different retro, such as a delayed project, with causes, actions and owners.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Write notes for another retro without looking at old notes.

rubric.label: Causes, actions, owners
rubric.description: The notes list causes and actions with owners and dates.

anchors.met: Each action has an owner and a date.
anchors.notMet: Causes and actions are mixed or owners are missing.

rubric.label: Blameless language
rubric.description: The notes describe process issues, not people.

anchors.met: Uses process language such as "the checklist did not include".

rubric.label: Retro vocabulary
rubric.description: Uses words such as root cause and action item.

anchors.met: Uses at least three retro terms correctly.
